basics.name: Doan Duc Khiem
basics.label: Bioinformatics Researcher & Data Scientist
basics.summary: Master's student in Data Analysis and Pattern Recognition at Institut Polytechnique de Paris with a strong background in Biomedical Engineering. Experienced in applying deep learning (GNNs, Transformers) to biomedical problems such as Drug Response Prediction and Traumatic Brain Injury prognosis. Passionate about theoretical statistical physics, biophysics, and personalized medicine.

work.name: BKAI Laboratory (Bioinformatics Research Team)
work.summary: Working with the Bioinformatics team on the Drug Response Prediction project. Developed novel multi-level information integrating fragment-level and atom-level GNN paradigms.
highlights: Proposed a novel paradigm bridging atom- and fragment-level representations using compact chemical vocabulary.
Achieved state-of-the-art performance on standard CCLE dataset for within-dataset drug response prediction.

work.name: International Research Institute MICA
work.summary: Conducting research on Traumatic Brain Injury (TBI) Classification using multimodal deep learning and NLP techniques.
highlights: First author of 1 journal paper and 1 conference paper.
Developed viTBI-BERT, a Vietnamese Language Model for TBI prediction.

publications.name: viTBI-BERT: A Vietnamese Language Model for Prediction of Traumatic Brain Injury
publications.publisher: Journal on Information Technologies & Communications, Vol. 2025, No. 1, pp. 54-67
publications.summary: First author. Developed a domain-adapted BERT model for TBI prediction using Vietnamese physician notes.

publications.name: TBI-TTM: Traumatic Brain Injury Prognosis with Textual Data under Missing Tabular Conditions
publications.publisher: The 24th International Symposium on Communications and Information Technologies (ISCIT 2025)
publications.summary: First author. Proposed a method to enhance robustness with missing data without imputation, increasing sensitivity by approximately 10%.

projects.name: Multimodal Traumatic Brain Injury Prognosis Assessment
projects.summary: Developed an end-to-end multimodal deep learning pipeline to predict TBI severity by fusing structured clinical data with unstructured physician notes from 503 patients. The model outperformed uni-modal baselines by 1–2% across four key metrics.
highlights: Fine-tuned a LLM domain-adapted BERT model achieving 71% sensitivity.
Used adjusted Transformer encoder to handle missing data without imputation.

projects.name: Drug Response Prediction System
projects.summary: Proposed a novel multi-level information integrating fragment-level and atom-level GNN paradigm. Bridges atom- and fragment-level representations using a compact chemical vocabulary and principal subgraph mining.
highlights: Achieved state-of-the-art performance on standard CCLE dataset.
Focused on within-dataset drug response prediction.

projects.name: Genomic Variant Analysis and Annotation
projects.summary: Analyzed germline and somatic variants using GATK. Practiced workflows for variant preprocessing, discovery, refinement, and evaluation.
highlights: Utilized tools: GATK, SAMtools, Picard, IGV.
Performed analysis using R and Python in Linux environment.
